purpose: Deterministic scientific actions for a discovery-first PUR Agent: first extract material-response structure from measured evidence, then use that structure to choose informative formulation-process experiments.

actions.name: get_state_aware_rheology_summary
actions.description: Return the paper's upstream rheological findings from pre-validation evidence only: formulation-only versus state-aware model comparison, the state-shift master-curve structure, one-point state calibration, the local apparent temperature-sensitivity coordinate, the E1/E5 thermal-hold drift contrast, and the verified E1 +P phosphoric-acid perturbation as a separate scale-versus-shape check. The E1 +P condition is 0.025 mmol H3PO4 from a 0.1 mol/L standard solution added during dehydration and is not pooled into the primary same-composition fit. Also returns explicit design rules and measurement implications. The validation formulation/outcome is excluded.
when_to_use: first, before candidate ranking
to identify which material-response regularities should control experiment selection
to decide whether a new point should target viscosity level, state calibration, thermal response, or hold stability

actions.name: get_chemistry_audited_rheology_summary
actions.description: Return the chemistry-provenance-audited local rheology result from original pre-validation measurements: same-order formulation/state comparison, model-free state-shift check, leave-one-formulation one-point calibration, apparent thermal-response descriptor, original hold contrast, and a separate verified E1 +P chemical-perturbation check. E1 +P is 0.025 mmol H3PO4 from a 0.1 mol/L standard solution added during dehydration; it remains outside the primary same-composition fit but its thermal-shape compatibility is returned. The validation formulation/outcome is excluded.
when_to_use: as the preferred local-science summary for new chemistry-first development
before deciding whether a discovered local rheological regularity can guide a new experiment
when a new Agent or ML layer needs audited material evidence rather than frozen benchmark compatibility output

actions.name: query_external_priors
actions.description: Retrieve source-level analogue evidence from the curated external PUR evidence table, including source identifiers, evidence locators, candidate-space role and limitations.
when_to_use: after the local physical failure mode is identified
when considering a formulation-family change
when local chemistry coverage is sparse

actions.name: get_candidate_hypothesis
actions.description: Return the evidence-derived candidate-space hypothesis, the original E2 reactive-core anchor, independent acrylic/tackifier axes and the historical/claim boundary. This supports experiment selection; it is not itself a discovered optimum.
when_to_use: after establishing the local design objective
before comparing candidate formulations

actions.name: inspect_formulation
actions.description: Inspect one measured formulation and compute transparent composition summaries including polyol, acrylic-like, tackifier-like, combined-modifier and MDI fractions.
when_to_use: to understand a measured reference state
to compare chemistry axes without conflating them with process state

actions.name: get_hold_stability
actions.description: Return measured thermal-hold trajectories and deterministic SI descriptors for a formulation. No extrapolation is performed.
when_to_use: when thermal stability is the observed failure mode
to compare candidate design objectives with original high-drift references

actions.name: get_repeatability_risk
actions.description: Return nominal repeat/run spread from measured temperature sweeps, including CV and max/min ratio where available.
when_to_use: before treating one nominal viscosity as a material property
when realization/process-state uncertainty may dominate

actions.name: get_temperature_support
actions.description: Return measured temperature support and descriptive temperature-response summaries for a formulation.
when_to_use: to avoid unsupported extrapolation
to choose an anchor temperature inside measured support

actions.name: audit_process_unknowns
actions.description: Audit missing reaction/preparation/hold metadata for a candidate or measured formulation and convert missingness into explicit process-history uncertainty.
when_to_use: before final experiment selection
when two candidates are compositionally similar but state uncertainty differs

actions.name: assess_shared_shape_applicability
actions.description: Check whether the locally discovered shared thermal-response shape is inside its validated chemistry support for a candidate. Returns a chemistry-family boundary and a measurement recommendation; it does not predict viscosity.
when_to_use: before using one-point state calibration on a new candidate
whenever AC1920, TK100 or another chemistry-changing modifier is introduced
to decide whether M-ANCHOR is defensible or a direct M-SWEEP verification is required

actions.name: candidate_profile
actions.description: Compute a candidate profile with separate acrylic-like and tackifier-like fractions instead of collapsing all modifiers into one number.
when_to_use: for every serious candidate
before comparing a candidate with class-specific external priors

actions.name: compare_candidate_to_priors
actions.description: Compare acrylic-like and tackifier-like axes separately with independent evidence anchors. Returns analogue support, not predicted wet-lab performance.
when_to_use: for resin-modified candidates
to identify supported versus extrapolative chemistry directions

actions.name: stress_test_candidate
actions.description: Apply deterministic risk flags using candidate-space support, process-history missingness and grid boundaries. It returns reasons, not a fabricated viscosity prediction.
when_to_use: before freezing an experiment point
to check whether a chemically plausible point remains interpretable under known uncertainties

actions.name: rank_candidate_support
actions.description: Create a transparent support-oriented ordering from the allowed evidence. This is a decision aid, not the scientific objective and not a trained property predictor.
when_to_use: only after the scientific objective has been derived from the measured rheology
when several candidates remain plausible

invariants: The Agent must identify the physical/material pattern before ranking formulation candidates.
The state-aware rheology tool may use only original pre-validation measurements and analyses derived from them; it must not expose the validation formulation or its outcome.
Candidate ranking is downstream of scientific pattern extraction and must target the observed failure mode or a high-value uncertainty.
Planner action arguments must satisfy the declared JSON parameter schema before execution.
Actions may expose only evidence allowed by the active evidence-access profile.
External analogue evidence is directional prior information, not proof of the current formulation's optimum.
Missing process history remains uncertainty rather than being silently set to ideal values.
No action may invent a molecular mechanism or an unmeasured viscosity value.

The local shared thermal-response shape must not be extrapolated into resin-modified chemistry as an established law; modified candidates require direct temperature-response verification before one-point calibration is trusted.
Frozen benchmark actions remain unchanged for provenance; new chemistry-first development should prefer the audited rheology action when it needs the manuscript-facing local regularities.
